screen.kohs_inventory_tweaks.title: KoHs Inventory Tweaks
screen.kohs_inventory_tweaks.world_requi: Join a world or server before configuring KoHs Inventory Tweaks.

screen.kohs_inventory_tweaks.subtitle: Tune the behavior, appearance, and scale of your inventory
screen.kohs_inventory_tweaks.keybind.pro: Press the key for the mod configuration menu
screen.kohs_inventory_tweaks.keybind.des: Click and press a keyboard key. The assignment is also available in Minecraft Controls.
screen.kohs_inventory_tweaks.cursor_land: Choose the exact cursor landing point for each supported inventory.
screen.kohs_inventory_tweaks.inventory_t: Reliability options for fast inventory openings.
screen.kohs_inventory_tweaks.issues_trac: Shows confirmed mod conflicts, affected hooks, and available compatibility handling.
KoHs only reports direct internal mutation, an exact required-method overlap, or confirmed cursor-coordinate control. Mods are not flagged merely for adding inventory features.
screen.kohs_inventory_tweaks.compatibili: Unavailable: a confirmed conflict paused this feature. See Issues Tracker.
screen.kohs_inventory_tweaks.issues_trac: This mod directly targets internal KoHs Inventory Tweaks classes through a mixin. Its behavior can replace or intercept KoHs logic.
This mod overwrites a Minecraft method used by KoHs. The replacement can remove an injection point required by an inventory feature.

This mod replaces the global screen-scale and mouse-coordinate pipeline used by KoHs container scaling. Running both transforms can desynchronize rendered slots from hit testing and leave GUI scale state inconsistent.
Ixeris and Raw Input Buffer both own the exclusive Windows raw-mouse pipeline. KoHs pauses only Cursor Landing and leaves every inventory feature available.

This mod controls a confirmed mouse-position hook. KoHs uses a bounded adapter only for verified integrations; otherwise Cursor Landing is paused. Genuine player movement is never continuously forced.
This mod redirects the same required invocation as KoHs. Only one redirect can own that call, so the combination would fail KoHs' mandatory injection check during startup.

A confirmed redirect overlaps KoHs inventory rendering. KoHs safely takes priority for that invocation; the conflicting redirect is suppressed while unrelated features from the other mod remain available.
screen.kohs_inventory_tweaks.compatibili: A confirmed technical overlap was detected. Remove the listed mod and restart for the safest result, or continue with KoHs guarded compatibility handling. No third-party files or mixins are modified at runtime.
screen.kohs_inventory_tweaks.blocking.in: KoHs Inventory Tweaks requires you to remove the following incompatible mod(s):
screen.kohs_inventory_tweaks.blocking.re: Reason: This mod and KoHs redirect the same required invocation. Mixin accepts only one redirect there, so KoHs would fail its mandatory injection check and crash startup.
Reason: A required KoHs invocation hook is inside a method overwritten by this mod. Applying both can fail during mixin transformation.

Reason: This mod and KoHs both control container scaling across screen extraction, renderer state, window GUI scale, and mouse-coordinate conversion. Applying both pipelines can desynchronize slots from input or crash the screen render path.
Reason: Ixeris and Raw Input Buffer both register the Windows raw-mouse device in exclusive NOLEGACY mode. Running both can leave Minecraft without camera movement. Remove either one.
Reason: This mod removes or replaces a required mouse-position hook, so KoHs cannot safely retain Cursor Landing authority.
Reason: This mod directly mutates internal KoHs classes before normal initialization.
screen.kohs_inventory_tweaks.blocking.sh: KoHs disabled all of its gameplay mixins and runtime services before they could modify Minecraft. Continuing is blocked. Remove the listed mod(s), then restart Minecraft.
notification.kohs_inventory_tweaks.mouse: %s overlapped cursor positioning; KoHs retained Cursor Landing priority.
%s controls mouse positioning. Cursor Landing and Center Mouse Fix were disabled; other features remain available.
screen.kohs_inventory_tweaks.customizati: Change inventory colors, transparency, and animated backgrounds.
Click to cycle through every Vanilla 26.1.2 inventory surface.

Customization affects every Vanilla container that displays inventory slots: the player inventory, chests, furnaces, workstations, Crafter, storage screens, trading, mounts, Creative inventory, and Bundle slots. Active resource-pack textures are used as the base, then your selected colors, opacity, and background are applied over them.
Opens a full-screen calibration over the visible world. The selected inventory size is physically locked and stays identical at Vanilla GUI Scale 1x, 2x, 3x or Auto; move the left slider upward for a larger size or downward for a smaller size.
Actual size: %s%% · preview fitted to this window

Rescaling overrides the vanilla size of the player inventory, including its text, slots, items, and character. Its final physical size stays fixed even if Vanilla GUI Scale changes. Containers remain vanilla unless Affect Containers is enabled; the global GUI scale itself is never changed.
screen.kohs_inventory_tweaks.affect_cont: This applies the selected inventory scale to single chests, double chests, Shulker Boxes, barrels, and Ender Chests. More screens, such as villager trading inventories, may be supported in future updates.
Images/GIF: max 2048 px. MP4/MOV H.264: min 176×166 and 1 s; max 10 s.
Image imported and fitted to the inventory.
Animated GIF imported for seamless looping.
Video converted locally to a looping GIF.
screen.kohs_inventory_tweaks.backdrop.de: Darkens the world behind every inventory. Depth intensity keeps already-visible players above that darkness; blocks still occlude them.

screen.kohs_inventory_tweaks.vanilla_cen: Vanilla center · click the preview to customize
screen.kohs_inventory_tweaks.center_mous: Places the custom or vanilla centered position exactly once during each player-inventory opening. It never affects containers, verifies later frames, drags, or continuously forces the cursor.
screen.kohs_inventory_tweaks.super_fast_: Opens at the first safe input-batch boundary. Holding an unshared inventory key will not toggle it repeatedly; release and press again to close. Recipe-search typing stays normal. Overlapping gameplay actions remain Vanilla-owned.
screen.kohs_inventory_tweaks.remove_anim: Freezes inventory-owned visual motion and removes transient snapback ghost copies without delaying mouse or keyboard input.

Animated backgrounds use one frame. Furnace and brewing progress, recipe cycling and bounce, the enchanting book, cycling slot hints, transient snapback copies, and animated enchantment foil inside inventory slots are hidden or frozen. HUD, held-item, entity, and world rendering stay Vanilla. Container logic, packets, clicks, keys, and transfer speed are unchanged.
screen.kohs_inventory_tweaks.unsaved.des: Your latest changes have not been saved. Exit anyway and discard them?
screen.kohs_inventory_tweaks.palette.hin: Choose a color from the palette.
screen.kohs_inventory_tweaks.item_highli: Highlight selected items in inventories and optionally in the hotbar.
Choose an item from the catalog. Its active resource-pack model will appear here.
While an inventory is open, all matching items light up only while the cursor is over one of them.
screen.kohs_inventory_tweaks.advanced.de: Profiles, smart rules, accessibility, container overrides, performance, safety, and keybinds.
screen.kohs_inventory_tweaks.advanced.co: Click to cycle through the accessible KoHs color palette.
screen.kohs_inventory_tweaks.advanced.op: Controls visual strength only and never affects items or input.
screen.kohs_inventory_tweaks.advanced.pr: Presets change behavior and performance but preserve colors, backgrounds, and selected items.
Returns behavior and motion to a clean Vanilla-style presentation.
Prioritizes clear slots, low motion, and low-durability warnings without changing packets.
Keeps full visuals and adds a clear hovered-slot guide for large inventories.
Freezes inventory motion and removes menu particles for the lightest visual load.
Applies one local preset when entering singleplayer and another when joining multiplayer.
Custom means that entering this context will not replace the current settings.
screen.kohs_inventory_tweaks.advanced.sm: Adds automatic visual rules after explicitly selected Item Highlighter entries.
Highlights damageable items when their remaining durability reaches the threshold.
Remaining durability percentage that activates the warning.
Highlights enchanted items that do not already have an explicit rule.
Shows automatic rules in the HUD hotbar as well as inventory slots.
screen.kohs_inventory_tweaks.advanced.ac: Adds a clear border around the slot currently under the pointer.
Animates only the accessibility border; Remove All Animations freezes it automatically.
Tints visible player models only while the player inventory is open and outside its panel.
Uses the ordinary model pass: blocks occlude it, the Vanilla wall-visible glowing pipeline is never used, and no packets change.
Blends the selected color into visible player textures.
Maximum local render distance for the tint.
Adds a subtle brightness pulse without changing world or entity state.
screen.kohs_inventory_tweaks.advanced.co: Container profiles use GUI Scaler and remain inactive while it is disabled.
Replaces the single global container size with individual local sizes.
Use inventory scale for all containers
Applies the main inventory scale to every currently supported container.
Disabled keeps this container at its Vanilla size.
Changes only this container and keeps slot hit testing aligned.
screen.kohs_inventory_tweaks.advanced.pe: 0 hides decorative particles; 100 is the default; 200 doubles them.
Caps GIF and converted-video frame updates without changing inventory input.
Maximum update rate used by the custom inventory background.
Shows the first frame while Minecraft is not the active window.
Temporarily lowers decorative menu particle count while Minecraft is unfocused.

screen.kohs_inventory_tweaks.advanced.ke: Click and press a keyboard key. Escape cancels the assignment.
The menu key does not match another Minecraft key mapping.
The same key is assigned elsewhere. Both mappings remain visible in Minecraft Controls.
screen.kohs_inventory_tweaks.profiles.de: Choose behavior presets and automatic singleplayer or multiplayer profiles.
screen.kohs_inventory_tweaks.advanced.ta: Automatically identify low-durability tools and enchanted items. Manual Item Highlighter rules keep priority, and every color and threshold is shown in the real inventory preview before you leave the editor.

Make normally visible players easier to distinguish while your inventory is open. Configure a colored model highlight and a depth-tested light glow. Blocks still hide players, and the inventory panel is always protected from the effect.
Improve pointer focus with a high-contrast hovered-slot frame, adjustable opacity, optional pulse and a full color palette. The preview uses the same slot resolver as the real inventory.
Give chests, Shulker Boxes, Ender Chests and barrels independent GUI scales. Each branch explains whether it uses Vanilla size or the saved custom value, and the preview shows the effective result.
Tune only decorative work: menu particle density, animated-background frame rate and unfocused-window reductions. Inventory input, clicks and packets are never accelerated or delayed.
Protect configuration changes with bounded undo and redo, automatic retained backups, sanitized JSON import/export and direct access to the export folder.
Change the configuration-menu key, detect assignments shared with other Minecraft controls and restore the default Y key without editing options.txt manually.
screen.kohs_inventory_tweaks.advanced.ca: Open the dedicated editor to see every option and its live preview.
screen.kohs_inventory_tweaks.advanced.ac: Tints the normally rendered player model with the selected palette color.
Raises only the submitted model lighting; geometry and blocks continue to occlude the player.
Controls how strongly visible player models are illuminated without adding a through-wall outline.
screen.kohs_inventory_tweaks.cursor.land: Lands the cursor on the slot holding this item instead of on the stored point, and falls back to that point when the item is not in the inventory. The offhand slot is never chosen. Hold an item and press to set it; press again to clear.
